workload: Full-observation digit classification, 49 patch-level Broadcast copies of a 16-pixel fragment
construction: Use the consumer's patch and head fragments, original count table in sorted matrix_cat member order, expected log likelihood digamma(count)-digamma(column total), uniform class prior and unbound label. Preserve the sixteen-pixel fan-out inside each patch. The only A/B edit is the outer Broadcast. Historical chain expansion is frozen at the runtime source above.
input: MNIST test images in original order, threshold >=128. Within each 4x4 patch flatten in row-major order. No retraining or random image selection.
backend: Apple M2 Max 64 GB, CPU, float64. Record backend, JAX and jaxlib versions at execution.
stopping: Require public converged status. The larger cap accommodates whole-graph message stationarity, which the historical classification measurement did not check. Record each performed sweep and report any failure. Verify class marginal against the direct sum of per-pixel expected log likelihoods.
timing: Same process A/B on the compiled sweep runtime. Separate first-use and warm. Warm wall includes DATA binding, run and requested class readout and synchronization, with graph and immutable initial state reusable. Report raw durations, per-image sweep counts, images/s, and synchronized solve ms per performed sweep separately. Do not infer a GPU or Craftax throughput result.
scale: Also compare 784-leaf count and initialized numerical arena bytes between topologies.
